scope: Fresh synthetic contexts; visible UI only, no direct database audit, no account or production testing

results.detail: Fresh local browser begins without seeded reflections.
Keep succeeds without mandatory Return or action.
Both possibilities and member-entered dialogue survive reload.
A stale-tab save is refused and the unsaved words remain visible.
Exact historical revision is not silently replaced by latest.
An unavailable revision does not fall back to another.
Temporal notes have an explicit departure warning and remain on cancel.
A member-selected connection and its counterexample are retained.
The relationship returns to the exact source version.
Deleting a source leaves a truthful unavailable relation.
Deleting both synthetic reflections returns the visible library to empty.
No-image/no-action session can return; Keep and leave preserves the explicit return.
Feared possibility offers distance without compulsory dialogue.
Keyboard cancellation preserves the unfinished encounter.
Explicit discard does not leave a visible saved reflection.
Arrival and encounter fit a 390px viewport without horizontal scrolling.
Visible mobile buttons meet the 16px type and 44px height floors.
Return remains directly reachable on mobile without filling earlier movements.
No JavaScript page errors or off-origin browser requests occurred during this walk.
Loopback preview identifies its bundle and emits the no-connect content policy.
